description: Machine-readable SAM -> OpenStudio analytical translation coverage manifest. One entry per SAM property/concept. Enum-backed entries have id '<EnumShortName>.<Member>' and MUST cover every live member of every enum listed in coveredEnums (enforced by reflection in the completeness tests). Statuses: Native (direct OpenStudio mapping), Derived (deterministically calculated from SAM data), Approximated (documented engineering assumption), Unsupported (no safe OpenStudio equivalent; structured diagnostic emitted when source data present), Deferred (detailed-HVAC programme), NA (no energy semantics / no source data / result-only slot; nothing to translate). The 'milestone' is where the final mapping lands (MVP = merged PR #7). docs/SAM_OPENSTUDIO_ANALYTICAL_COVERAGE.md is generated from this file and must not be parsed by tests.
deferredDomains: Compliance workflows (NCM, Part F, Part O)
